## 主张 Claim

目标 wisdom-root（核心揭示智慧不可缺少的构成关系，并解释其形成、成立与失败）的形式部分，在第一部分所及范围内完成：下列已检查的规律都对每个形成、每个学习者、每个归并、每个选择或每个确定的律陈述，不用公理，各自的条件写在定理中，所以保留相同内容的任何表示都避不开它们。识：主张只经所识的差别被否证（Web.Refutes.not_of_alike），无记录固定下一个（Web.tail_unrefuted、no_record_fixes_next）。理（Ren 的读法：对结构与变化之规律的建模）：数据单独不固定任何未试之值（every_determines_nothing），推广恰在归并之处、正确恰在世界经归并同去之处（determines_lumped_iff、lumped_right_iff），结构与变化是同一个归并（goAlike_iff_lumped），投影恰在相同者同去时承载规律（carries_law_iff）。检验：相对于模型的否证是对模型与主张一起的否证（Web.refutesWithin_iff_conjunction），记录只在取过之处固定动作的结果（Run.not_fixes_of_untaken），重复是返回（Run.fixes_on_return），一次场合代表经模型相同的类（Run.generalizes）。学习：被列表所持的世界中按否证学习的否证有界、静止不能被否证、其记录从不表明它已静止（held_learner_bounded、held_rest_unrefuted、no_record_fixes_next_finite），每个学习者都有否证它每个主张的开放的序列（diagonal_refutes、diagonal_open）。明（他者之识）：清除者不能检验的栖居者能，合起来能检验各自都不能的（Clearing.tested_by_dweller、Clearing.pooled），经识的选择在识闭包之外不见，合起来的识选出它（Flow.unselected_beyond_registration、Clearing.selected_pooled）。够：寻求恰在到达律所不变、满足其目标的状态时静止（Law.rests_iff），“比现在更多”需要开放的世界（more_needs_open），“高于一切他者”的两个寻求者从不同时静止（Law.aboveAll_never_rests）。失控：断裂之前断裂还有多远不被识（Web.break_not_bounded），观察储量则识之（Web.observed_raise_registers）。代理：选择与训练只经选择者之识或数据（Web.selects_alike_iff、Training.loss_through），数据之外的值与类同样自由（Training.unselected_beyond_data），伸出识闭包之外而抬高所识者被选中（Diversion.favours）。判断：由识作出的判断恰是判断过程在信念上的共同回应（commonResponse_judge_iff、Web.belief_judge_iff）。元层次：对类的学习是合并枚举上的同一学习（merged_bound），每种合并都有其对角序列（merged_unrested），改变自身规则的系统的规律在联合配置上（adaptive_state_law_iff）。形成的形式路线：按否证学习从记录形成模型，习得链从三次接触形成对全部表达式的解释（uniform_determines），Hebb 式发展与更新路线是联合配置上的律（hebbian_activity_law_iff、updating_network_law_iff），回应路线在失败处学习（responsive_learns）。 / The formal part of the target wisdom-root (that the core reveals the relations indispensable to wisdom and explains their formation, warrant and failure) is completed at the scope Part I reaches: the following checked laws are each stated for every formation, learner, lumping, selection or determined law, with no axiom and their conditions written into the theorems, so no representation keeping the same content escapes them. Registration: a claim is refuted only through a registered difference (Web.Refutes.not_of_alike), and no record fixes the next value (Web.tail_unrefuted, no_record_fixes_next). 理 (Ren's reading: the modeling of the laws of structure and change): data alone fix no untried value (every_determines_nothing), generalization reaches exactly what a lumping lumps and is right exactly where the world goes alike across it (determines_lumped_iff, lumped_right_iff), structure and change are one lumping (goAlike_iff_lumped), and a projection carries a law exactly where configurations alike go alike (carries_law_iff). Testing: refutation relative to a model refutes the model and the claim together (Web.refutesWithin_iff_conjunction), the record fixes an act's outcome only where taken (Run.not_fixes_of_untaken), replication is return (Run.fixes_on_return), and one occasion stands for its class under the model (Run.generalizes). Learning: in a world held by a list learning by refutation is refuted a bounded number of times, its coming to rest is unrefuted and its record never shows that it has come to rest (held_learner_bounded, held_rest_unrefuted, no_record_fixes_next_finite), and every learner has an open course refuting each of its claims (diagonal_refutes, diagonal_open). 明 (others' registration): what the clearer cannot test the dweller can, and together they test what neither can alone (Clearing.tested_by_dweller, Clearing.pooled); selection through registration is blind beyond the registration closure and pooled registration selects what it misses (Flow.unselected_beyond_registration, Clearing.selected_pooled). Enough: seeking rests exactly at a state the law leaves unchanged that meets its target (Law.rests_iff), “more than now” needs an open world (more_needs_open), and two seekers of “above all others” never rest together (Law.aboveAll_never_rests). Runaway: before the break, how far it is does not register (Web.break_not_bounded), while observing the stock registers it (Web.observed_raise_registers). Proxies: selection and training go only through the selector's registration or the data (Web.selects_alike_iff, Training.loss_through), values beyond the data stay as free as the class leaves them (Training.unselected_beyond_data), and reaching beyond the registration closure to raise what registers is selected (Diversion.favours). Judgment: a judgment from registration is exactly a common response of the judging process over the belief (commonResponse_judge_iff, Web.belief_judge_iff). The meta level: learning over classes is the same learning over a merged enumeration (merged_bound), every merging has its diagonal course (merged_unrested), and a system changing its own rule has its law on the joint configuration (adaptive_state_law_iff). The formal routes of formation: learning by refutation forms a model from the record, the acquisition chain forms an interpretation of every expression from three encounters (uniform_determines), Hebbian development and the route of updating are laws on the joint configuration (hebbian_activity_law_iff, updating_network_law_iff), and the responsive route learns where the task fails (responsive_learns).
